name: SecurityTrails (API and web pages)
tier_rationale: SecurityTrails, part of Recorded Future, Inc., is an established company with published terms and paid plans (A8 trusted); P006 trusted and P304 cond 5 'trusted - ... SecurityTrails'.

reliability.justification: Large passive-DNS and historical DNS collection: historical records keep first/last seen and old A records are never current infrastructure (P006 cond 5).

securitytrails.plan_hint: business = a company/team SecurityTrails plan, never an analyst's personal free account (P006 cond 2): the free plan targets individuals, so corporate use needs key_plans.securitytrails='business' or a recorded free_plan_business_use

api.title: SecurityTrails API v1 (domain, subdomains, DNS history, ips/nearby)

terms.quote: The free plan targets individuals, so under the corporate profile it runs only when legal records that the plan permits internal business use (registry free_plan_business_use=true) or key_plans.securitytrails='business' (A1).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P006 cond 2); research C0017 terms '[live_cti] Recorded Future/SecurityTrails terms' (verified_needs_key 401). The terms page sits behind Cloudflare (403 to scripts). api.securitytrails.com/v1/domain/{domain}, /v1/domain/{domain}/subdomains (labels without the apex: append it and validate through the shared hostname sink) and /v1/history/{domain}/dns/a; key in the APIKEY header (P006 cond 1, 3). 429 and quota-exceeded bodies give RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA, 401/403 NEEDS_KEY, never EMPTY (P006 cond 6). Merge only with trimmed real fixtures captured with the team key plus the existing 401 fixture (P006 cond 8). Used by securitytrails.

web_pages.title: SecurityTrails web pages (manual pivot links; Cloudflare-protected)

terms.quote: Free web UI; provider ToS apply (manual analyst use)

web_pages.notes: Quote: research C0061 terms (status unverified 403: Cloudflare, P006 cond 7). securitytrails.com/domain/{domain}/dns and /list/ip/{ip}: manual pivot links only (A9), never fetched. Used by pivots_unverified.

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G01-1, p2-G14-3, p3-G13-1 (P006, P278, P304): batches only extend it (securitytrails__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Quota: monthly window at <= 80% of the plan's limit (P006 cond 4); the free tier allows about 50 queries per month (research C0017, observed) -> key budget, published false until the team plan is recorded. run_on seeds; cache 7 days (P006 cond 4). cdn_origin_hypothesis (P278) only consumes P006 facts and never calls this API (P278 cond 1).
